tools.name: cedulon_spend
tools.description: Policy-gated spend on the mock rail. Allow returns a signed COSE receipt JSON. Deny returns the fail-closed reason.

amount.description: Integer amount as a decimal string

tool.description: Calling tool name recorded on the request

tools.name: cedulon_audit
tools.description: Reconcile the in-process receipt chain and checkpoint against the rail extract: this server's own ledger, or a signed extract you present. Returns audit: balanced or findings, names the account, rail and window it was computed over (scope) when an extract declared one, and counts the class every receipt and row landed in (counts).

extract.description: A signed rail extract you were presented with: { body: { accountId, railId, windowStartMs, windowEndMs, settlements: [{ ref, amount, currency, timestampMs }], clockSkewMs? }, signature, publicKeyPem }. Present, it is the settlement side of the audit: this server's in-process settlement rows are not consulted, rows added through extraSettlements are refused beside it (an empty list adds nothing and is accepted), and the result carries scope. The receipt side is still this server's own receipt chain and checkpoints, so an extract for an account or rail this server did not settle on reports this server's receipts as unmatched; that is the correct reading of that pairing, not a defect. A body the library would refuse to sign (malformed window, amount outside the grammar, negative clock skew), an empty account, rail or signature, or a key that is not a PEM is refused as extract: ... before anything is reconciled. Absent, the audit runs over this server's own ledger and declares no scope.

trust.description: Rail key you hold out of band: { publicKeyPem: string | string[], accountId?, railId?, windowStartMs?, windowEndMs? }

issuerTrust.description: Issuer key(s) you hold out of band: { publicKeyPem: string | string[] }. Without it the audit checks this server's records against this server's own key.

witnessTrust.description: Transparency log key you hold out of band: { publicKeyPem: string | string[] }

payeeTrust.description: Payee keys you hold out of band, keyed by payee: { "payee-1": publicKeyPem }

manifest.description: A Trade Manifest you were presented with. Omit for a no-manifest deployment. Present without manifestTrust is unauthenticated-manifest.

manifestTrust.description: Manifest publisher key(s) you hold out of band: { publicKeyPem: string | string[] }

extraSettlements.description: Optional extra extract rows, used to inject a bypass settlement in tests

tools.name: cedulon_verify_receipt
tools.description: Verify a spend receipt COSE_Sign1 (and payee countersignature when present). Supply expectIssuerKeyPem to check it against a key you already hold; without one the receipt is only checked against the key it carries, which any key satisfies.

expectIssuerKeyPem.description: Issuer key you hold out of band. Omit and the check is self-referential.

expectPayeeKeyPem.description: Payee key you hold out of band, for the countersignature.

tools.name: cedulon_export_ledger
tools.description: Export receipts, checkpoint, and rail extract in the same JSON shape as npm run demo:export, with the findings, guarantee and counts of the audit over this server's own ledger.

tools.name: cedulon_status
tools.description: Server version, policy summary, receipt count, and chain head hash.
